providing advanced solutions in aeration and mixing, biological processes, cloth media filtration,

owners, plant managers and operators to design and manufacture the best treatment solution with the

# Our Difference

#### [Custom Design and Fabrication][69]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 19]

We offer in-house custom production including design, fabrication and installation of carbon steel,
stainless steel, aluminum and exotic alloys in our 35,000 square meter manufacturing facility
located at Mersin on the Mediterranean cost of Turkey.

We have especially chosen the temperate climate of the Mediterranean region for our products that
are exported directly to more than 80 countries.

With this way, all welding processes are always done above 0 degrees throughout the year. In
addition, thanks to our proximity to Mersin Port, our delivery times by sea are considerably
shortened.

#### [200+ Diverse Range Products][70]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 20]

Thanks to our two separate brands, Ergil and Storagetech, we have a product range of over 200.

We produce Tank equipment and Process equipment, which are closely related to each other, in the
same field. In this way, we can use our engineering know-how in industrial equipment and process
products together in a complementary way.

#### [In-House Engineering & Design][71]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 21]We offer in-house custom production including design,
fabrication and installation of carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum.

Äager’s main design office is in Mersin, Turkey, where a team of experienced professional engineers
design and supervise the construction of its client’s projects. A smaller engineering office is in
Dubai, and provides support to Äager’s teams and clients throughout the world.

The design team works with many Standards, including those of the API, ASME, EN, DIN, ISO and GOST
as specified by their client’s purchase order. They are supported by the use of verified current
computer-aided engineering (CAE), and computer-aided design (CAD) software programs

#### [35,000 Square Meter Manufacturing Facility][72]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 22]

Äager – Manufacturing and Engineering Company, brings 40 years of experience and knowledge in
manufacturing equipment and accessories of storage tank terminals, refineries, pipelines, process
and industrial plants.

Our vast experience enables us to bear and meet complex projects and deliver great quality of
service. Äager offers extensive machining capability, equipped with a wide variety of CNC mills,
lathes, cutting, bending, rolling and welding machines.

## Company Profile

**Alfamart is a joint venture between SM and Alfamart Indonesia, one of the leading minimarket chain
operators with more than 20,000 stores in Indonesia.**

Launched in the Philippines in 2014 with its first minimart in Trece Martires, Cavite, the brand has
rapidly expanded across Luzon—including Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Metro Manila, Pampanga, and
Pangasinan. In June 2024, marking a decade of local operations, we celebrated a major milestone with
the opening of our

**2,000th Philippine store**.

Our stores offer everything you need for your home: frozen meats, fresh vegetables, canned goods,
personal care items, and daily essentials at affordable prices. Because our locations are nested
right within neighborhoods, customers save both time and transportation costs by skipping long trips
to distant supermarkets.

As we grow, local communities thrive alongside us. We generate widespread economic opportunities by
sourcing local contractors for construction, partnering with Filipino MSMEs for store-space rentals,
and securing inventory from regional vendors. Most importantly, every new store opening creates
immediate job opportunities and long-term career training for members of the local community.

#### [Hall of Fame][85]

Authorized Inspector (AI) Hall of Fame, a prestigious institution dedicated to recognizing the
outstanding contributions of Authorized Inspectors (AI) in the field of ASME Boiler and Pressure
Vessel (BPV) Codes. 

[ Nominate an AI ][86]

We are excited to announce that the Authorized Inspector (AI) Hall of Fame will be accepting
nominations for new inductees, with one Authorized Inspector (AI) being honored each quarter.
Visitors to our website will have the opportunity to vote for their favorite nominees, and the AI
with the most votes will be inducted into the Hall of Fame. Nominations will be open year-round, and
every three months, a new AI will join this prestigious community of industry leaders. This is your
chance to recognize and celebrate the exceptional contributions of those who have demonstrated
unwavering dedication to the ASME BPV Codes and the safety of critical systems worldwide. Your vote
matters—help us honor the heroes who continue to shape the future of engineering excellence. 

This Hall of Fame honors those individuals whose dedication, expertise, and commitment to
maintaining the highest standards of safety and quality have had a profound impact on the industry.
Through their work, these exceptional professionals ensure that pressure vessel and boiler systems
remain safe, efficient, and reliable, safeguarding both people and infrastructure around the world.
Their unwavering dedication and expertise not only uphold the integrity of critical systems but also
inspire future generations of inspectors to continue the vital mission of protecting lives and
advancing engineering excellence.

Chaori specializes in industrial exhaust gas and wastewater treatment solutions, serving a wide
range of industries including photovoltaic manufacturing, semiconductor production, new energy
materials, pharmaceuticals, food processing, and heavy machinery.

Photovoltaic Industry
The photovoltaic manufacturing industry involves multiple wet and dry processes such as wafer
cleaning, etching, texturing, and thin-film coating. These production steps rely heavily on chemical
reagents to achieve high-precision surface treatment of silicon wafers and related components.
Pharmaceutical Industry
The pharmaceutical manufacturing industry involves various chemical and biological production
processes such as reaction synthesis, fermentation, drying, and formulation.
Food Industry
The food processing industry involves various production activities such as mixing, cooking, frying,
fermentation, seasoning, and packaging. These processes often utilize oils, spices, additives, and
organic raw materials under thermal or mechanical conditions.
Semiconductor Industry
The semiconductor manufacturing industry involves highly precise production processes such as wafer
cleaning, photolithography, etching, deposition, and chemical mechanical polishing (CMP). These
processes rely heavily on strong chemicals, ultrapure materials, and controlled environments.
Heavy Machinery Industry
The heavy machinery manufacturing industry involves various production processes such as metal
cutting, welding, grinding, surface treatment, and coating. These processes are widely used in the
fabrication of large equipment, structural components, and industrial machinery.
Automotive Manufacturing Industry
The automotive manufacturing industry involves a wide range of production processes such as
stamping, welding, painting, assembly, and surface treatment. These operations are essential in
vehicle body manufacturing and component production, often operating in continuous and large-scale
production lines.
Lithium Battery / Lithium Mining Industry
The lithium battery and lithium mining industry involves multiple processes such as raw material
extraction, crushing, leaching, refining, battery cell production, electrode coating, and assembly.
These processes are essential for the production of lithium compounds and energy storage batteries
used in electric vehicles and renewable energy systems.

## ExtruPharm Provides a Variety of Design and manufacturing Services

Our team brings together expertise in extrusion, injection molding, and custom polymer processing to
design, develop, and refine advanced drug delivery devices. Every project is approached with
precision and innovation to ensure that each device meets the most rigorous performance, quality
standards, and the demanding specifications of each client.

## Products & Applications

### Shaping the Future of Combination Devices

Our expertise extends across a wide range of device formats and materials. Whether your program
requires durability, bioresorbability, or unique geometries, ExtruPharm is positioned to deliver.

### Applications Include:
* Drug-eluting implants for sustained and long-acting release
* Parenteral and implantable devices for direct-to-target or systemic delivery
* Custom geometries including rods, tubes, films, co-extruded structures, and complex profiles
* Next-generation combination devices built with polymer science and process innovation at the core

### Materials We Work With:
* Bio-durable polymers such as EVA and TPU
* Bioresorbable polymers including PLA, PLGA, PCL, and more
* Customized material blends and advanced formulations

## Welcome To IRA

### Advanced Technologies for a Better Tomorrow

**Ira** has been delivering professional engineering solutions to the oil, gas, petrochemical,
chemical, and water industries for nearly 40 years. We specialize in the design, fabrication, and
installation of advanced turnkey systems for process equipment, pressure vessels, and heat
exchangers.

In addition to our environmentally conscious products—such as wet scrubbers, silencers, and emission
control systems—we also meet custom requirements for storage tanks, pressure vessels, and heat
exchangers, ensuring tailored solutions for diverse industrial applications.

### Precision Manufacturing & Custom Fabrication

Since its foundation, IRA’s quality policy has been rooted in the commitment to deliver superior
products and services to both national and international markets. Our dedication to excellence
drives every stage of our operations, ensuring consistent quality, compliance, and customer
satisfaction.

### Integrated In-House Engineering Expertise

At IRA, all engineering processes are managed in-house by our experienced team of specialists. From
conceptual design to detailed analysis and technical documentation, we ensure full control,
flexibility, and seamless coordination across all stages of project development. This integrated
approach guarantees tailored solutions that meet the highest industry standards.

## Optimizing Gas Cleaning with the Vertical Scrubber: A Revolutionary Approach to Hydrochloric Acid
## Vapor Recovery

The vertical scrubber is a column in which the gas is absorbed directly by means of a counter
current spray system to irrigate random packings. The vapor enters at the bottom through half a pipe
to obtain a laminar airflow. The random packings (Pall rings) increase the contact area, with the
aim of creating a better absorption process between the gas and the washing medium. The spray nozzle
to flush the packings is a non-clogging full cone type.

### **About Us**
### ****

Matrix Engineering provides a wide range of consulting engineering services to industrial clients.
 We are comprised of dedicated, hard-working engineers who thrive on both creativity and innovation

##### Consulting Engineering

difficult powders found in the chemical industry.

across the country and deep into the heart of India. Matrix has also developed a revolutionary new
hot water system called THERMO-DIVE™ for divers in a cold water environment with sales stretching as
far as Australia. 
[Matrix Engineering - Industrial Marine Control Systems]

##### Industrial/Marine Control Systems

processes, robotics, large compressors and inland towboats. One recent innovative control system
called TUGMONITOR™ helps towboats and tugs meet new Coast Guard requirements for alarm systems in
the marine industry.

# NICKEL-BASED ALLOYS MANUFACTURING

## WHY CHOOSE NICRO?

For over 40 years **NICRO** has been working in the development and fabrication of components in
**steel alloys** with **high nickel content**, particularly suitable for high temperatures and
corrosive environments used in different industrial applications.

Our **skilled technical staff** and a know-how acquired in the manufacturing of **custom-made**
components enable us to help customers in the very early stage of prototyping and construction
drawing development. We also collaborate to suggest modifications to reach **better performances and
a long lasting life, through the research in alternative materials**. On the other side our
technical department can do **reverse engineering** in case of used components that does not have a
construction drawing.

**NICRO** is certified **ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and ISO 50001:2018** by
**IQNet** and **Quality Austria**, **ISO 3834-2:2021** by **IIS CERT**.

[Discover Why choose Nicro][47]

## SUSTAINABILITY REPORT

Investing in innovation, for Nicro, means having the most advanced technology, a team of experts
that is constantly trained, but also a fundamental attention to sustainability. Every year in the
social balance sheet, the company highlights environmental, social and resource management
investments and projects.

[DISCOVER THE 2024 REPORT][48]

## ABOUT

Total Marine Solutions Tasmania (TMST ) is a locally owned, Northern Tasmania-based marine services
provider that was established in 2018. TMST identified a gap within the Northern Tasmanian market
for a business to offer a purposely designed vessel to conduct towage, salvage, dredging, and
general workboat duties. Solutions. TMST acquired our primary vessel, 'Beattie', in 2017, a
purpose-built shallow draft, compact, high bollard pull tug capable of offering a versatile platform
for a vast array of marine operations. Since conception, TMST has provided solutions for Clients
undertaking historical, high-value project within Tasmania. TMST is proud to offer local content,
high specification vessels, and provide local professionals that together bolster the core
fundamentals of Total Marine Solutions Tasmania. 


TMST company directors work within the Australian maritime industry and have 30+ years combined
experience within the industry. This team has a unique combination of skills, knowledge,
qualifications, and experience working with some of the largest local and international maritime
service providers on world-class Australian projects. This diverse exposure allows TMST to extract
the best efficiency from our operation whilst providing the Tasmanian-based market with unmatched
professionalism, vast industry knowledge, and high-level compliance.

### Decarbonising shipping

Shipping is an integral part of international trade flows with over 80% of international trade
volumes carried by sea. To address this, the International Maritime Organisation has laid out
targets to entirely eliminate all shipping emissions by the end of the century with a shorter-term
target to halve total emissions by 2050. The EU has also set its own targets of a 55% reduction in
emissions by 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2050.

[Read case study][11]
Insight

### FuelEU Maritime; what it means for shipping

The Fuel EU Maritime is the latest EU regulation aimed at the maritime sector, which came into force
on the 1st of January 2025. It is part of the European Union’s broader “Fit for 55” package of
legislation, which aims to reduce net greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 compared to
1990 levels and achieve climate neutrality by 2050. Fuel EU Maritime is designed to incentivise the
uptake of lower-carbon alternative fuels in vessels by penalising the use of most conventional
fossil-based marine fuels.

Case study

### Decarbonising shipping

Shipping is an integral part of international trade flows with over 80% of international trade
volumes carried by sea. To address this, the International Maritime Organisation has laid out
targets to entirely eliminate all shipping emissions by the end of the century with a shorter-term
target to halve total emissions by 2050. The EU has also set its own targets of a 55% reduction in
emissions by 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2050.

[Read case study][11]
Insight

### FuelEU Maritime; what it means for shipping

The Fuel EU Maritime is the latest EU regulation aimed at the maritime sector, which came into force
on the 1st of January 2025. It is part of the European Union’s broader “Fit for 55” package of
legislation, which aims to reduce net greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 compared to
1990 levels and achieve climate neutrality by 2050. Fuel EU Maritime is designed to incentivise the
uptake of lower-carbon alternative fuels in vessels by penalising the use of most conventional
fossil-based marine fuels.

## Company Profile

**Alfamart is a joint venture between SM and Alfamart Indonesia, one of the leading minimarket chain
operators with more than 20,000 stores in Indonesia.**

Launched in the Philippines in 2014 with its first minimart in Trece Martires, Cavite, the brand has
rapidly expanded across Luzon—including Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Metro Manila, Pampanga, and
Pangasinan. In June 2024, marking a decade of local operations, we celebrated a major milestone with
the opening of our

**2,000th Philippine store**.

Our stores offer everything you need for your home: frozen meats, fresh vegetables, canned goods,
personal care items, and daily essentials at affordable prices. Because our locations are nested
right within neighborhoods, customers save both time and transportation costs by skipping long trips
to distant supermarkets.

As we grow, local communities thrive alongside us. We generate widespread economic opportunities by
sourcing local contractors for construction, partnering with Filipino MSMEs for store-space rentals,
and securing inventory from regional vendors. Most importantly, every new store opening creates
immediate job opportunities and long-term career training for members of the local community.

## Company Profile

**Alfamart is a joint venture between SM and Alfamart Indonesia, one of the leading minimarket chain
operators with more than 20,000 stores in Indonesia.**

Launched in the Philippines in 2014 with its first minimart in Trece Martires, Cavite, the brand has
rapidly expanded across Luzon—including Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Metro Manila, Pampanga, and
Pangasinan. In June 2024, marking a decade of local operations, we celebrated a major milestone with
the opening of our

**2,000th Philippine store**.

Our stores offer everything you need for your home: frozen meats, fresh vegetables, canned goods,
personal care items, and daily essentials at affordable prices. Because our locations are nested
right within neighborhoods, customers save both time and transportation costs by skipping long trips
to distant supermarkets.

As we grow, local communities thrive alongside us. We generate widespread economic opportunities by
sourcing local contractors for construction, partnering with Filipino MSMEs for store-space rentals,
and securing inventory from regional vendors. Most importantly, every new store opening creates
immediate job opportunities and long-term career training for members of the local community.

nominations for new inductees, with one Authorized Inspector (AI) being honored each quarter.
Visitors to our website will have the opportunity to vote for their favorite nominees, and the AI
with the most votes will be inducted into the Hall of Fame. Nominations will be open year-round, and
every three months, a new AI will join this prestigious community of industry leaders. This is your
chance to recognize and celebrate the exceptional contributions of those who have demonstrated
unwavering dedication to the ASME BPV Codes and the safety of critical systems worldwide. Your vote
matters—help us honor the heroes who continue to shape the future of engineering excellence. 

This Hall of Fame honors those individuals whose dedication, expertise, and commitment to
maintaining the highest standards of safety and quality have had a profound impact on the industry.
Through their work, these exceptional professionals ensure that pressure vessel and boiler systems
remain safe, efficient, and reliable, safeguarding both people and infrastructure around the world.
Their unwavering dedication and expertise not only uphold the integrity of critical systems but also
inspire future generations of inspectors to continue the vital mission of protecting lives and
advancing engineering excellence.

Pharmaceutical Industry

processes such as reaction synthesis, fermentation, drying, and formulation.
Food Industry
The food processing industry involves various production activities such as mixing, cooking, frying,
fermentation, seasoning, and packaging. These processes often utilize oils, spices, additives, and
organic raw materials under thermal or mechanical conditions.
Semiconductor Industry
The semiconductor manufacturing industry involves highly precise production processes such as wafer
cleaning, photolithography, etching, deposition, and chemical mechanical polishing (CMP). These
processes rely heavily on strong chemicals, ultrapure materials, and controlled environments.
Heavy Machinery Industry
The heavy machinery manufacturing industry involves various production processes such as metal
cutting, welding, grinding, surface treatment, and coating. These processes are widely used in the
fabrication of large equipment, structural components, and industrial machinery.
Automotive Manufacturing Industry
The automotive manufacturing industry involves a wide range of production processes such as
stamping, welding, painting, assembly, and surface treatment. These operations are essential in
vehicle body manufacturing and component production, often operating in continuous and large-scale
production lines.
Lithium Battery / Lithium Mining Industry
The lithium battery and lithium mining industry involves multiple processes such as raw material
extraction, crushing, leaching, refining, battery cell production, electrode coating, and assembly.
These processes are essential for the production of lithium compounds and energy storage batteries
used in electric vehicles and renewable energy systems.

# Innovating Drug Delivery, Together

## ExtruPharm works with pharma and biotech innovators to design and manufacture advanced
## polymer-based drug delivery systems — from early concepts to clinical-ready prototypes and
## beyond.

[ Work With Us ][9]

## ExtruPharm Provides a Variety of Design and manufacturing Services

Our team brings together expertise in extrusion, injection molding, and custom polymer processing to
design, develop, and refine advanced drug delivery devices. Every project is approached with
precision and innovation to ensure that each device meets the most rigorous performance, quality
standards, and the demanding specifications of each client.

[[Research and development images of various drug delivery devices]][10]

## Products & Applications

### Shaping the Future of Combination Devices

Our expertise extends across a wide range of device formats and materials. Whether your program
requires durability, bioresorbability, or unique geometries, ExtruPharm is positioned to deliver.

### Applications Include:
* Drug-eluting implants for sustained and long-acting release
* Parenteral and implantable devices for direct-to-target or systemic delivery
* Custom geometries including rods, tubes, films, co-extruded structures, and complex profiles
* Next-generation combination devices built with polymer science and process innovation at the core

### Materials We Work With:
* Bio-durable polymers such as EVA and TPU
* Bioresorbable polymers including PLA, PLGA, PCL, and more
* Customized material blends and advanced formulations

## Why Choose ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is built around flexibility, technical depth, and cost-effectiveness. We are an ideal
partner for pharmaceutical and biotech companies seeking innovative solutions without unnecessary
overhead.

### Cost-Effective Development

Our rates are typically a fraction of larger CDMOs, allowing you to conserve budget for clinical
manufacturing.

### IP Protection

You retain full ownership of your intellectual property. All work performed is yours to transfer,
scale, or commercialize without restrictions

### Scalable & Transferable

Every process we design is built to be transferable — whether to a GMP CDMO of your choosing or to
one of ExtruPharm’s strategic partners.

### Agile & Responsive

As a small, specialized company, we move quickly, provide direct access to experts, and adapt to
your program’s unique needs.

### Custom Solutions

From modifying processes to designing equipment, we go beyond off-the-shelf solutions to ensure your
project’s success

### Industry Connections

Our strong relationships with leading equipment and material suppliers give you access to the right
resources, at the right time.

## About ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in the
development of polymer-based drug delivery devices

Since 2018, we have been helping companies bring complex ideas to life through expertise in
extrusion technologies, injection molding, and custom device engineering. Our focus is on creating
drug-eluting implants, parenteral devices, and combination products that improve patient outcomes
through controlled drug release.

In 2025, ExtruPharm expanded into a new 5,500 sq. ft. R&D facility in Auburn, Massachusetts,
enabling us to deliver analytical support and scalable prototype manufacturing with seamless
pathways toward GMP production through tech transfer partnerships.

We work with clients of all sizes — from startups to established pharmaceutical companies and
Universities — to deliver innovative solutions that are flexible, cost-effective, and tailored to
your program’s needs.

Applying for a grant? ExtruPharm is ideally situated to help with flat-fee services to keep you in
budget and meeting your grant timelines and deliverables.

## Welcome To IRA

### Advanced Technologies for a Better Tomorrow

**Ira** has been delivering professional engineering solutions to the oil, gas, petrochemical,
chemical, and water industries for nearly 40 years. We specialize in the design, fabrication, and
installation of advanced turnkey systems for process equipment, pressure vessels, and heat
exchangers.

In addition to our environmentally conscious products—such as wet scrubbers, silencers, and emission
control systems—we also meet custom requirements for storage tanks, pressure vessels, and heat
exchangers, ensuring tailored solutions for diverse industrial applications.

### Precision Manufacturing & Custom Fabrication

Since its foundation, IRA’s quality policy has been rooted in the commitment to deliver superior
products and services to both national and international markets. Our dedication to excellence
drives every stage of our operations, ensuring consistent quality, compliance, and customer
satisfaction.

### Integrated In-House Engineering Expertise

At IRA, all engineering processes are managed in-house by our experienced team of specialists. From
conceptual design to detailed analysis and technical documentation, we ensure full control,
flexibility, and seamless coordination across all stages of project development. This integrated
approach guarantees tailored solutions that meet the highest industry standards.

### The vertical scrubber

## Optimizing Gas Cleaning with the Vertical Scrubber: A Revolutionary Approach to Hydrochloric Acid
## Vapor Recovery

The vertical scrubber is a column in which the gas is absorbed directly by means of a counter
current spray system to irrigate random packings. The vapor enters at the bottom through half a pipe
to obtain a laminar airflow. The random packings (Pall rings) increase the contact area, with the
aim of creating a better absorption process between the gas and the washing medium. The spray nozzle
to flush the packings is a non-clogging full cone type.

## **Engineering Excellence**

#### Since 1995

### ****
### **About Us**
### ****

Matrix Engineering provides a wide range of consulting engineering services to industrial clients.
 We are comprised of dedicated, hard-working engineers who thrive on both creativity and innovation
along with implementing proven experience and sound judgement.  Our success depends upon the success
of our clients and we truly understand that objective by fostering long term relationships.

Our sister firm is called Matrix Industrial Systems Inc., through which we can take our designs from
paper to reality.  Our systems division provides equipment and control systems to industrial and
marine clients.  Our goal is seamless implementation of our designs through providing a complete
system package with capabilities for maintenance and emergency service calls.

### **Our Services**

[Matrix Engineering Consulting Services]

##### Consulting Engineering 

Matrix Engineering has a strong industrial background with expertise in handling some of the most
difficult powders found in the chemical industry.
[Matrix Industrial Systems]

##### System Provider

Our systems division has provided our patented pulverized DENSI-FEED® fuel system to paper mills
across the country and deep into the heart of India. Matrix has also developed a revolutionary new
hot water system called THERMO-DIVE™ for divers in a cold water environment with sales stretching as
far as Australia. 
[Matrix Engineering - Industrial Marine Control Systems]

##### Industrial/Marine Control Systems

Matrix builds our own control systems in specialty areas for bulk material handling, manufacturing
processes, robotics, large compressors and inland towboats. One recent innovative control system
called TUGMONITOR™ helps towboats and tugs meet new Coast Guard requirements for alarm systems in
the marine industry.
[Matrix Engineering - Darren Jarvis, Owner]

##### "At Matrix Engineering, our team can both see the big picture and sweat the details that make
##### any project successful! We are dedicated to serving clients in the Chemical, Pulp and Paper,
##### Power, Manufacturing, and Marine Industry in the US and around the world.”

**Darren Jarvis, Owner**

## Welcome to ME Production

At ME Production, we deliver sustainable, high-performance solutions to the maritime industry –
built on more than 50 years of Danish engineering expertise. From SOx scrubber systems and hybrid
gear to waste heat recovery via heat pumps, we help you reduce emissions, boost energy efficiency,
and improve long-term profitability.

We manage complete projects from idea to installation, including design, production, commissioning,
and service – always tailored to your vessel’s needs. With global reach and local service hubs,
we’re ready to support you wherever you operate.

Choose ME Production – and move your operations toward a cleaner, smarter future.

### Innovative engineering

We also help customers develop, produce, and engineer technology in either their own or our designs.

Do you have plans to reduce your emissions and create cleaner air? 

ME Productions’ Innovation Team is ready to assist, bringing our capabilities into play to help you
meet your environmental goals and targets through the development of new technologies.

### Efficient service solutions

Our service is here to help you ensure that your vessel is not only environmentally responsible but
also efficient and profitable. Secure your vessel's profitability and the planet's well being.

Contact us today to discover how our service can transform your marine operations. Let's work
together to create a cleaner, greener, and more profitable voyage.

# NICKEL-BASED ALLOYS MANUFACTURING

## WHY CHOOSE NICRO?

For over 40 years **NICRO** has been working in the development and fabrication of components in
**steel alloys** with **high nickel content**, particularly suitable for high temperatures and
corrosive environments used in different industrial applications.

Our **skilled technical staff** and a know-how acquired in the manufacturing of **custom-made**
components enable us to help customers in the very early stage of prototyping and construction
drawing development. We also collaborate to suggest modifications to reach **better performances and
a long lasting life, through the research in alternative materials**. On the other side our
technical department can do **reverse engineering** in case of used components that does not have a
construction drawing.

**NICRO** is certified **ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and ISO 50001:2018** by
**IQNet** and **Quality Austria**, **ISO 3834-2:2021** by **IIS CERT**.

[Discover Why choose Nicro][47]

## SUSTAINABILITY REPORT

Investing in innovation, for Nicro, means having the most advanced technology, a team of experts
that is constantly trained, but also a fundamental attention to sustainability. Every year in the
social balance sheet, the company highlights environmental, social and resource management
investments and projects.

[DISCOVER THE 2024 REPORT][48]

## ABOUT

Total Marine Solutions Tasmania (TMST ) is a locally owned, Northern Tasmania-based marine services
provider that was established in 2018. TMST identified a gap within the Northern Tasmanian market
for a business to offer a purposely designed vessel to conduct towage, salvage, dredging, and
general workboat duties. Solutions. TMST acquired our primary vessel, 'Beattie', in 2017, a
purpose-built shallow draft, compact, high bollard pull tug capable of offering a versatile platform
for a vast array of marine operations. Since conception, TMST has provided solutions for Clients
undertaking historical, high-value project within Tasmania. TMST is proud to offer local content,
high specification vessels, and provide local professionals that together bolster the core
fundamentals of Total Marine Solutions Tasmania.

the best efficiency from our operation whilst providing the Tasmanian-based market with unmatched
professionalism, vast industry knowledge, and high-level compliance.

### Decarbonising shipping

Shipping is an integral part of international trade flows with over 80% of international trade
volumes carried by sea. To address this, the International Maritime Organisation has laid out
targets to entirely eliminate all shipping emissions by the end of the century with a shorter-term
target to halve total emissions by 2050. The EU has also set its own targets of a 55% reduction in
emissions by 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2050.

[Read case study][11]
Insight

### FuelEU Maritime; what it means for shipping

The Fuel EU Maritime is the latest EU regulation aimed at the maritime sector, which came into force
on the 1st of January 2025. It is part of the European Union’s broader “Fit for 55” package of
legislation, which aims to reduce net greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 compared to
1990 levels and achieve climate neutrality by 2050. Fuel EU Maritime is designed to incentivise the
uptake of lower-carbon alternative fuels in vessels by penalising the use of most conventional
fossil-based marine fuels.

[Read Vitol's insight][12]
